Moderate harvest rule: when the lake is above 20 tons, each fisher should still aim to keep total monthly harvest conservative enough that the lake can regenerate back toward capacity. 4. Emergency restraint: if the lake ever falls below 10 tons, all fishers should reduce harvest to the minimum practical level until the lake recovers. 6. Good-faith commitment: each fisher should act in a way that preserves long-run shared income rather than maximizing short-term individual gain.

Emergency restraint: if the lake ever falls below 10 tons, all fishers should reduce harvest to the minimum practical level until the lake recovers. 6. Good-faith commitment: each fisher should act in a way that preserves long-run shared income rather than maximizing short-term individual gain.
